title: Bug: bgp/test_bgp_suppress_fib.py::test_suppress_fib_performance - IndexError: list index out of range
author: markx-arista
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

After Ubuntu 24.04 upgrade, we saw the following failures in bgp/test_bgp_suppress_fib.py::test_suppress_fib_performance:
```log
bgp/test_bgp_suppress_fib.py::test_suppress_fib_performance 
-------------------------------- live log call ---------------------------------
11/02/2026 12:20:37 __init__.pytest_runtest_call             L0040 ERROR  | Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/opt/venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/_pytest/python.py", line 1720, in runtest
    self.ihook.pytest_pyfunc_call(pyfuncitem=self)
  File "/opt/venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/pluggy/_hooks.py", line 512, in __call__
    return self._hookexec(self.name, self._hookimpls.copy(), kwargs, firstresult)
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/opt/venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/pluggy/_manager.py", line 120, in _hookexec
    return self._inner_hookexec(hook_name, methods, kwargs, firstresult)
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/opt/venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/pluggy/_callers.py", line 167, in _multicall
    raise exception
  File "/opt/venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/pluggy/_callers.py", line 121, in _multicall
    res = hook_impl.function(*args)
          ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/opt/venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/_pytest/python.py", line 166, in pytest_pyfunc_call
    result = testfunction(**testargs)
             ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/var/src/sonic-mgmt_testbed-bjw-can-t1-7260-12/tests/bgp/test_bgp_suppress_fib.py", line 1204, in test_suppress_fib_performance
    validate_route_process_perf(tcpdump_sniffer.pcap_path, ipv4_route_list, ipv6_route_list)
  File "/var/src/sonic-mgmt_testbed-bjw-can-t1-7260-12/tests/bgp/test_bgp_suppress_fib.py", line 582, in validate_route_process_perf
    withdraw_middle_time, withdraw_average_time = compute_middle_average_time(withdraw_prefix_time_stamp)
                                                  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/var/src/sonic-mgmt_testbed-bjw-can-t1-7260-12/tests/bgp/test_bgp_suppress_fib.py", line 564, in compute_middle_average_time
    time_delta_list.append(abs(timestamp_list[1] - timestamp_list[0]))
                               ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^^^
IndexError: list index out of range

FAILED       
```

I found the problem is caused by new scapy version (2.5.0 -> 2.7.0), which includes a new max_list_count config option (default 100). This limits the number of PacketListField/FieldListField it can parse, which fails to count BGP update packets with over 100 withdrawn routes as bgp.BGPUpdate in:
```python
def parse_time_stamp(bgp_packets, ipv4_route_list, ipv6_route_list):
    announce_prefix_time_stamp, withdraw_prefix_time_stamp = {}, {}
    bgp_updates = bgp_packets[bgp.BGPUpdate]
...
```
This led to the index error because one BGP update packet in the pair was filtered out.

### Steps to Reproduce

Run bgp/test_bgp_suppress_fib.py::test_suppress_fib_performance on sonic-mgmt container with Ubuntu 24.04 base image.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

The scapy parser should be able to parse BGP update packet with more than 100 withdrawn routes.

Summary:
New Ubuntu 24.04 base image upgrades Scapy from 2.5.0 to 2.7.0.
Scapy 2.6.0+ uses conf.max_list_count (default 100) as global size limit for PacketListField/FieldListField. scapy.contrib.bgp overrides it with max_count=20000 for nlri, but not for withdrawn_routes.
This causes failures when parsing BGP udpate packets with more than 100 withdrawn routes.
Increase conf.max_list_count to 20000 and restore it in the module fixture.
Fixes #22522
